_about: Puritan Manifestoes: a study of the origin of the Puritan revolt, with a reprint of the Admonition to the Parliament (Field and Wilcox, 1572) and kindred documents, edited by W. H. Frere and C. E. Douglas (London: SPCK for the Church Historical Society, 1907). Published before 1930, so public domain in the US; the editors' own notes are 1907 work. The name check is on Frere, named on the title page. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
